# Aimad Ul Islam — Cybersecurity & Network Security Portfolio

> Cybersecurity student, SOC enthusiast, and network security learner from Pakistan. BSc Computer Science, Cisco certified.

## About
Aimad Ul Islam is a Cybersecurity student, SOC analyst enthusiast, and network security learner based in Pakistan. Specializes in Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR), Security Operations Center (SOC) monitoring, Cisco networking, and ethical hacking.

## Professional Focus
- Security Operations Center (SOC) Analysis & Threat Detection
- Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR)
- Network Security Engineering & Cisco Systems
- Threat Hunting & SIEM Log Analysis
- Vulnerability Assessment & Ethical Hacking

## Featured Projects



- [Automated Volatility 3 Memory Forensic Parser](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/projects/automated-memory-forensics/): A Python-based automated memory analysis parser that extracts processes, network sockets, DLL injections, and suspicious handles from Windows RAM dumps using Volatility 3.





## Security Research & Whitepapers



- [Zero-Trust Architecture &amp; Microsegmentation Framework 2026](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/research/zero-trust-architecture-2026/): An architectural guide on establishing zero-trust access, identity-aware proxies, and granular eBPF microsegmentation across hybrid multi-cloud environments.





## Virtual Security Labs & Walkthroughs



- [Enterprise Active Directory &amp; SOC Homelab Range](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/labs/active-directory-homelab/): Multi-VM Enterprise Active Directory lab featuring Windows Server 2022 Domain Controller, Windows 11 workstation targets, Sysmon, Splunk Universal Forwarders, and pfSense firewall segmentation.





## Technical Blog & Writeups



- [Google Dorking: The Complete Guide to Advanced Search Operators, Finding Hidden PDFs, and OSINT Reconnaissance](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/google-dorking-the-complete-guide-to-advanced-search-operators-finding-hidden-pdfs-and-osint-reconnaissance/): Google Dorking is one of the most powerful OSINT techniques in cybersecurity. This comprehensive guide covers every advanced search operator, teaches you how to find hidden PDFs and books using directory listings, explores the Google Hacking Database, and provides a defensive playbook for protecting your own site. (Published: 2026-10-03)




- [The Silent Threat in Your Living Room: Analyzing Modem Malware and the Chuck Norris Botnet](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/the-silent-threat-in-your-living-room-analyzing-modem-malware-and-the-chuck-norris-botnet/): Your computer has antivirus. Your firewall has an IDS. But what about your ADSL modem? This deep dive explores how attackers infect embedded broadband devices, the lifecycle of the Chuck Norris botnet, and the cutting-edge memory forensics used to extract malware from routers. (Published: 2026-09-21)




- [Web Security for Developers: The Complete Guide to Building Secure Websites](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/web-security-for-developers-the-complete-guide-to-building-secure-websites/): Discover the most critical web vulnerabilities—SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, and session hijacking—and learn how to defend against them with practical code examples and modern security best practices. (Published: 2026-09-17)




- [100 Free Security Tools: The Ultimate Verified Guide for Ethical Hackers and Forensic Investigators](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/100-free-security-tools-the-ultimate-verified-guide-for-ethical-hackers-and-forensic-investigators/): The ultimate curated, fact-checked arsenal of 100 free security tools for ethical hackers and forensic investigators. Every tool verified for active maintenance, industry relevance, and practical usability — with dead or discontinued tools removed. (Published: 2026-09-13)




- [DLL &amp; Code Injection: Build a Stealthy Python Backdoor from Scratch](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/python-backdoor-injection/): Master remote thread creation, DLL injection, and code injection to build a professional-grade Python backdoor with process execution redirection. (Published: 2026-08-05)




- [Educational Keylogger: How Keyboard Monitoring Works &amp; Defenses](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/educational-keylogger-guide/): A deep dive into the mechanics of keyloggers, storage methods, and defensive strategies—strictly for educational purposes. (Published: 2026-08-02)




- [Metasploitable 2: The Ultimate Beginner&#39;s Guide to Exploitation](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/metasploitable-complete-guide/): Learn how to hack Metasploitable 2 from scratch using Metasploit – exploit vsftpd, UnrealIRCd, and more. (Published: 2026-07-25)




- [Getting Started with Kali Linux: Complete Beginner Setup Guide](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/kali-linux-setup-guide/): Set up your ethical hacking lab from scratch — VirtualBox, Kali Linux, Metasploitable 2, and DVWA. (Published: 2026-07-15)




- [Nmap Deep Dive: From Port Scanning to Full Network Enumeration](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/nmap-complete-guide/): Master Nmap — every flag, scan type, NSE script, output format, and professional methodology explained with real examples. (Published: 2026-07-10)

- [Linux Essentials: Every Command You Actually Need](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/linux-essentials-guide/): From file permissions to bash scripting — the complete Linux reference guide for cybersecurity professionals. (Published: 2026-06-28)




- [Python for Hackers: Security Automation Scripts from Scratch](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/python-for-security/): Port scanners, password sprayers, subdomain enumerators — building real security tools in Python from scratch. (Published: 2026-06-20)
